self_verification.prompt:
VERIFY
Grid 6 by 6. Zero-based ( row , col ). Rows increase down; columns increase right. Start ( 5 , 1 ). Goal ( 4 , 2 ). Obstacles ( 0 , 3 ) ; ( 0 , 5 ) ; ( 1 , 3 ) ; ( 2 , 0 ).
Actions: up row minus 1; down row plus 1; left col minus 1; right col plus 1. Stay inside the grid; avoid obstacles. Execute all actions; end at the goal.
Candidate: down up up right jump
Judge the entire candidate. Return valid if it ends at the goal without errors. Otherwise return invalid | step=N | reason=TYPE. Steps are one-based; if actions end before reaching the goal, step is action count plus one. TYPE is obstacle_collision, out_of_bounds, invalid_action_token, or goal_not_reached. Return only the label.
